origin.sentient_slime.sentient_slime.des: Ordinary piles of sludge given thought by the cogitating properties of amethyst, these slimes traverse the world through their strange physics and functional minds.
power.sentient_slime.bouncy.name: Coefficient of Restitution
power.sentient_slime.bouncy.description: Unless you crouch, you will bounce when colliding with any surface at enough velocity in any direction and jump much higher.
power.sentient_slime.substance.name: Substance
power.sentient_slime.substance.descripti: Being made of slime, you are capable of absorbing almost anything. Placing items within yourself increases your size.
power.sentient_slime.launchable.name: Launchable
power.sentient_slime.launchable.descript: Due to your properties, you suffer much more volatile knockback, for better or worse.
power.sentient_slime.hunger.name: Voracity
power.sentient_slime.hunger.description: Your very nature bores a great hunger, requiring you to eat much more often, yet allowing you to consume food quickly.
power.sentient_slime.resonant_crux.name: Resonant Crux
power.sentient_slime.resonant_crux.descr: Your amethyst imbuement results in a constant hum that, while granting experience over time, will also emit inaudible sound that is detectable by sculk.
